title: Java Slide 8
description: Practice test covering object-oriented programming concepts including access modifiers, constructors, the 'this' reference, enums, statics, finals, composition, and BigDecimal precision.

questions.prompt: Review the following code. What is the exact result of attempting to compile and run this program?

options.text: Compile-time error: uninitialized variables might not have been initialized
Compile-time error: Test does not define a no-argument constructor

questions.explanation: If no constructors are defined, the compiler supplies a default no-argument constructor. Uninitialized static and instance variables of type int are automatically assigned the default value of 0.

questions.prompt: Examine the constructor logic in the Time class. What is the exact result of compiling and running this code?

options.text: Compile-time error: call to this must be first statement in constructor
Compile-time error: this(...) cannot be used to call another constructor

questions.explanation: When a constructor uses this(...) to call another constructor, it must be the absolute first statement in the constructor body. Placing a print statement before it causes a compilation error.

questions.prompt: Analyze the instantiation of the enum type. What is the exact result when this code is compiled and run?

options.text: Compile-time error: enum cannot declare a constructor
Compile-time error: enum types cannot be instantiated

questions.explanation: Enum constants are implicitly final and static. Attempting to create a new instance of an enum type using the 'new' keyword is strictly prohibited and results in a compilation error.

questions.prompt: Observe how the static method interacts with the class members. What is the precise result?

options.text: Compile-time error: static method cannot access a private variable
Compile-time error: non-static variable this cannot be referenced from a static context

questions.explanation: Static methods cannot utilize the 'this' reference because 'this' must refer to a specific instantiated object, and static methods can be called when no objects exist in memory.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the overloaded constructor initialization and variable shadowing. What will this program output?

options.text: Compile-time error: variable hour is already defined
Compile-time error: SimpleTime() no-argument constructor is undefined

questions.explanation: The statement 'hour = hour' assigns the local parameter to itself (a no-operation). The instance variable 'this.hour' is shadowed and remains untouched at its initial value of 1.

questions.prompt: Review the initialization paths for the final instance variable. What happens when this code is compiled?

options.text: Compile-time error: variable MAX_USERS might not have been initialized
Compile-time error: final variable MAX_USERS cannot be assigned in a constructor

questions.explanation: A final instance variable must be initialized directly at declaration or inside every single constructor. The no-argument constructor fails to initialize MAX_USERS, causing a compilation error.

questions.prompt: Examine the following code utilizing the BigDecimal API for precision arithmetic. What is the result?

options.text: Compile-time error: unhandled exception type ArithmeticException

questions.explanation: BigDecimal defaults to exact calculations. Dividing 1 by 3 produces a non-terminating decimal. Without specifying a MathContext or rounding mode, the divide method throws an ArithmeticException.

questions.prompt: Analyze this implementation of object composition. What is the exact printed output?

options.text: Compile-time error: hireDate has private access in Employee
Compile-time error: Date class must be public

questions.explanation: The Employee object holds a reference to the original Date object (3/12). Reassigning the local reference variable d1 to point to a new Date object (5/20) does not alter the original object stored within the Employee.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the interaction between String immutability and a shared static reference. What is the final printed output?

options.text: Compile-time error: static variable log cannot be updated from non-static method

questions.explanation: Strings are immutable. log.concat(msg) creates a new String but does not reassign it to the 'log' reference. The += operator creates a new concatenated string and safely reassigns the shared static variable 'log', resulting in 'Start-Run'.

questions.prompt: Determine the exact control flow resulting from chained constructors and exception handling. What is the output?

options.text: Compile-time error: this() must be the only statement in a constructor

questions.explanation: The main method calls the no-arg constructor, which immediately delegates to the two-arg constructor via this(). Since 25 >= 24, an IllegalArgumentException is thrown, immediately terminating both constructors before "B" and "A" can print. Control skips "C" and flows straight to the catch block, printing "D".
